1865_farm.method: Rigid similarity: Richmond Rd, Tates Creek Pike and Cooper Dr ink line-fitted to mask-traced modern centrelines, pinned by the Tates Creek/Cooper corner, Richmond toll house and Ashland house
1865_farm.distortion: Zero (single rotation + uniform scale; no local warping)
1865_farm.notes: Three-road fit (first three points are inputs, the rest checks). Sheet road ink off modern centreline: Richmond 4.0 px, Tates Creek 8.6 px, Cooper Dr 8.8 px. The hand-drawn 1865 features (race track, cemetery, ponds, hemp barn) sit where the sheet places them relative to its street base and are not forced onto modern finds.

1877_beers.method: Similarity: scale from the plate's printed 1-mile circle (194.1 px), rotation/position from Richmond Pike line-ICP and the two Tates Creek Pike bends
1877_beers.notes: Scale from the printed 1-mile circle; roads fitted, house symbols are checks. Plate-ink distance to modern centreline: Richmond 12.6 px, Tates Creek 18.4 px (the plate's upper Tates Creek reach is surveyed too close to Richmond). The 1877 Richmond Pike Toll Ho. lands by the former Shriners campus, ~1 km from Ashland, not at Chinoe. County-atlas source upscaled 2.8x; linework is soft.

1949_aerial.method: Least-squares similarity on all 5 Thompson markers (oval, /wall, 3 dots)
1949_aerial.notes: Warped from the clean 1600x900 raw frame, not the slide render; film border masked transparent.

1965_aerial.method: Least-squares similarity on all 5 Thompson markers (oval, /wall, 3 dots)
1965_aerial.notes: Slide render used (photo was cropped when placed in PowerPoint); non-photo slide area masked transparent.

master_recon.method: Planar homography (least squares) on 5 building/site correspondences
master_recon.distortion: Perspective rectification of an oblique Google Earth view
master_recon.notes: Slide 5 is a tilted 3D view (Idle Hour implies +15 deg, reservoir +34 deg under a similarity), so an affine cannot fit it. Add 3-4 road-intersection pairs to tighten.

1800_1900_purchases.method: 90 deg CCW true-north rotation + similarity pinned on the Chinoe & Fontaine junction ticks with Richmond Rd line-ICP
1800_1900_purchases.distortion: Zero (no shear; plat is drawn to scale)
1800_1900_purchases.notes: Richmond Rd double line sits 4.3 px off the modern centreline; Ashland house and Mansfield are checks only. Deed list / title block masked out.
